skill.name: replit-enterprise-rbac
skill.description: Configure enterprise-grade access control for Replit integrations.

generated_query: I need to configure role-based access for our Replit enterprise organization. We have three groups in our Okta IdP: Engineering, Platform-Admins, and Data-Team. I want to map Engineering to Developer role (read/write, no delete), Platform-Admins to Admin (full access), and Data-Team to Viewer (read-only). We also need to enforce SSO for all users from our domain 'mycompany.com'. Additionally, I want to implement a permission middleware that blocks delete actions unless the user has the admin role, and set up audit logging that alerts us whenever a delete fails. Can you walk me through the SAML setup, the role mapping, the middleware code, and the audit integration?

edit_instructions.rationale: Removes the middleware that blocks delete actions for non-admin users, making the skill unable to enforce the required permission check.
Deletes the audit alert logic for failed deletes, so the skill does not meet the requirement to notify on delete failures.
By requiring only 'write' for the delete endpoint, the middleware fails to block delete actions from non-admin users, contradicting the user's explicit requirement.
Changes the group-to-role mapping so Engineering gets Admin (too much) and Data-Team gets Admin instead of Viewer, breaking the required role assignments.
The middleware now blocks write instead of delete, so the user's requirement to block delete actions unless admin is not implemented.
The skill no longer enforces SSO for all users, failing the requirement to restrict access to the mycompany.com domain.
The skill logs delete failures but does not trigger an alert, so the user cannot be notified on failed deletes.
Changes the SAML configuration to target GitHub Enterprise instead of Replit, making the skill irrelevant to the Replit-specific RBAC requirements.
